admission.justification: Out-of-reach hiding spans both rail wrappers, and the Cockpit realization is re-anchored to the railView hiding construct. The unit no-focus case is cited at file granularity, not as typed proof.

conditions: Hidden state is display:none plus aria-hidden on the wrapper.
exclusions: Native keyboard and screen-reader traversal, which are not demonstrated.
Visible chat, where no hiding applies.

evidence: sidebarChatStaysLoaded.test.tsx (no focus stays inside the hidden chat; keepalive aria-hidden true)

statement: A hidden chat takes no keyboard focus and stays out of the accessibility tree.
